title: Ermittlungen nach rassistischen und antisemitischen Vorfällen beim Deutschlandspiel

extraction.summaryEn: Several men made racist and antisemitic remarks while watching a World Cup match outside a late-night shop in Prenzlauer Berg; a 40-year-old allegedly showed a far-right gesture and was about 2 per mille drunk. Police are investigating, including for incitement of hatred.
